title: Larkspur Sentinel Technologies
text:
Larkspur Sentinel Technologies

notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for user-facing features (in-app support assistant, doc search, reranking for insights). Started on hosted API to validate latency & quality, now moving to Dedicated for throughput predictability and data isolation.

POC details: 3-week POC (sample corpus of product docs + support transcripts), evaluation metrics: latency <200ms for chat, 99th pct token latency target, embeddings throughput ~200 req/s, rerank precision measured on held-out relevance set. Test volume ~50k tokens/day initially, projected 300k tokens/day at scale.

Pricing & procurement: Interested in committed Dedicated pool with monthly reserved capacity + burst credits. Pricing ask: committed discount tiers and clear add-on pricing for burst. Procurement asked for an indicative 12-month committed pricing schedule to feed into budget. Estimated ARR range to procurement team: $50k–$200k.

Security/legal: Primary blockers are MSA/DPA redlines. Key legal asks from Larkspur counsel: lower vendor liability cap (negotiation on cap tied to ARR), carveouts for third-party data processing, explicit data residency language (US-only), and DPA language around sub-processors. SOC2 Type II report requested; Redwood KMS/HSM integration details requested for key management. Vendor onboarding checklist requested from Redwood security.

Operational notes: Want VPC peering and private endpoints (no public data plane). Prefer single-tenant Dedicated pool in us-east region. Need onboarding timeline (target: 2–3 weeks after contract). SE (Miguel) to deliver runbook for prefix/KV caching and batching config for their workload.

Quotes from calls: "Latency is non-negotiable for our support flows — anything above 200ms kills UX." — Eng lead.  "We can move fast on budget if legal signs off; procurement has Q2 headroom." — Head of Finance.

Next immediate actions: 1) Legal to consolidate redlines and send to Redwood GC; 2) Redwood to provide SOC2 report + security answers v2; 3) Pricing team to produce committed Dedicated quote and 12-month schedule; 4) Schedule vendor onboarding + technical kickoff week of 2026-03-04.

Links: pricing deck (drive://redwood/pricing/larkspur-dedicated-proposal.pdf), security answers (drive://redwood/security/larkspur-security-answers_v2.docx). Jira/Support: RDW-8421 ticket tracks POC infra requests (VPC/networking), RDW-8599 tracks pricing questions.

timeline:
2026-01-20 - Initial inbound trial signup; AE outreach (Alicia) - interested in hosted API for rapid prototyping
2026-01-25 - Hosted API demo: chat + embeddings; latency targets discussed (<200ms chat, 150ms median embeddings), Miguel joined
2026-01-28 - Follow-up call (Fireflies ff_20260128_0930): customer requests cost estimates for steady state and burst; sent pricing worksheet
2026-02-10 - POC kickoff (Fireflies ff_20260210_1745): 3-week POC scoped - sample dataset, reranking pipeline, 50k tokens/day baseline
2026-02-18 - Security questionnaire submitted; asked for SOC2 report, encryption/KMS details, VPC peering steps
2026-02-24 - Demo of dedicated pool concept + autoscale options; procurement expressed preference for reserved capacity with burst
2026-02-28 - Legal submitted MSA/DPA with redlines; awaiting Redwood counter; procurement calendars show Q2 budgeting window

next_step:
Legal to provide redline response to MSA/DPA; schedule vendor onboarding call week of 2026-03-04

blockers:
MSA redlines on indemnity/liability cap
DPA data residency clause clarification
Procurement budget approval (Q2)
SOC2 report receipt
